blocks.text: The spat over President Lee Jae Myung’s social media activities continues, intensifying over the weekend with the president defending against criticisms as well as using online platforms to go on the offensive. On Saturday, Lee again took to X to refute criticisms about his activities, specifically against his overseas trips, which critics have attacked for lacking substance while incurring unnecessary spending. In the post, Lee said that the trips have “a high work intensity where intravenous therapy is often needed to cure nosebleeds.” Lee also claimed on X that the differing work intensity between his trips and those of former presidents […]...
